proposed_clause_text./clock_contract/rule: Authenticate the issuer's original fixed finite bounds and map them once at admission to an independently reviewed local elapsed-time clock domain under an explicitly enumerated conforming host kernel/hardware/hypervisor assumption. Preserve the original boot/clock-domain identity, exact mapping, fixed deadlines and durable budget. Suspend elapsed time must be accounted for or further effects denied before resume; missing/unknown mapping, boot drift, observed or suspected discontinuity, snapshot/restore or provider loss blocks effects. No clock fallback, deadline renewal, budget refill or right revival.
proposed_clause_text.local_clock_trust_assumption: Only specifically identified host kernel/time infrastructure, hardware and hypervisor behavior following the reviewed policy/specification are trusted for elapsed-time integrity. Deliberate hidden clock-domain manipulation or snapshot rollback by those assumed-trusted actors is outside this proposed integrity guarantee. It is not guaranteed detectable; observed/suspected violations invalidate admission. Ordinary suspend, restart, scheduler delay and timer loss remain in-scope reviewed failures. No actual provider or clock ID is selected.
